news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues and EPS in line with analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹20.71 (up from ₹17.92 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹45.1b (up 22% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.56b (up 16% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) were also in line with analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Healthcare industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 30% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.54 (down from ₹5.32 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.4b (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹950.2m (down 34% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.3% (down from 15% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 35%. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 21% growth forecast for the Healthcare industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 18% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
